title: Erdős–Hajnal Conjecture
exact_target: For each forbidden induced graph, must every graph avoiding it have a clique or independent set whose size is a fixed positive power of its order?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1328 (GRAPH-004). CC BY 4.0.
Maria Chudnovsky, Alex Scott, Paul Seymour and Sophie Spirkl, \emph{Erdős--Hajnal for graphs with no 5-hole} (2021), arXiv:2102.04994v1, Section 1, Conjecture 1.1.
